description: No resume call arrives before the bounded wait window elapses (production: 30 minutes; tested with a temporarily shortened 15-second window).
prerequisite: A pending execution from valid_human_review.json; simply do not call the resume URL.
observed_result: Verified with a temporarily shortened 15s wait: after the window elapsed with no resume call, the workflow auto-continued and sent a second notification with approval_status=EXPIRED, reviewer_note=''. Execution status=success (not stuck/hung).
